authority_note: Every runtime, package and installer the bootstrap may converge is pinned here to an exact version and a checksum/signature the converger verifies before anything executes. A pin whose verification material is null is OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED: the converger refuses to install it and prints the exact owner command that records the pin. Nothing here is ever fetched by curl|bash or @latest. Values are recorded by the owner from the vendor's published artefacts (GAP-007 / closure item 1); this repository does not invent checksums.

how_to_record.installer: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o <file> <url>; sha256sum <file>   -> sha256; record the vendor version the installer pins (VERSION/--version flag)
how_to_record.apt: apt-cache policy <package> on the target Ubuntu 24.04 host -> exact candidate version; Ubuntu archive signatures are verified by apt itself
how_to_record.apt_signed_repo: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o key <keyring_url>; sha256sum key -> keyring_sha256 (compare against the vendor-published fingerprint before recording)
